title: The embedded chart has no controls of its own
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an owner/admin (or any user with the Reports permission) on the build under test; a single workplace is selected.
  2. A report page with its embedded chart shown.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the embedded chart has no date-range control of its own.
2. Confirm the embedded chart has no technician or advisor filter of its own.
3. Confirm the embedded chart shows no report link.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The embedded chart has no date-range control of its own.
  • The embedded chart has no technician or advisor filter of its own.
  • The embedded chart shows no report link.
